game_concept: A strategy race set in Mystic Forest – Owl Roost, a night-time owl roost: the wood elf archer must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Picker: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it.
theme: Mystic Forest – Owl Roost: a night-time owl roost
core_gameplay_loop: In Owl Roost, repeat each round: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the wood elf archer ahead. Then check the picks_right value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the spirit shrine by solving code steps involving picks_right that move the wood elf archer forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the spirit shrine first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Loop Picker
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
